author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Boston’s post-Labor Day calendar moves from heavy metal to jazz, salsa and Caribbean carnival events over the next five days.

Iron Maiden is scheduled to bring its Run For Your Lives tour to TD Garden on Wednesday, September 9, with Megadeth on the bill, according to Axios Boston’s weekly events guide. On Thursday, Catherine Bent’s Antenna trio is due to perform at Long Live Roxbury from 6 to 9 p.m.

Saturday’s Embrace Massó ¡Con Salsa! Block Party is set for Summer Street Plaza from 3 to 7 p.m., headlined by El Gran Combo de Puerto Rico. The week closes Sunday with the 32nd Cambridge Carnival International in Central Square from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.

The events vary in ticketing and admission, and schedules can change. Attendees should confirm details with each organizer before traveling, especially for outdoor programming. Taken together, the lineup highlights the range of regional cultural programming that resumes immediately after the holiday weekend, from arena touring acts to neighborhood-scale performances and public festivals.
dek: Iron Maiden, a Roxbury jazz trio, a free salsa block party and Cambridge Carnival anchor a busy post-Labor Day calendar.
headline: Boston week ahead spans metal, salsa and carnival
